title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
summary: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

title: Ethena launches USDe payments app, offers 6% rewards
summary: The self-custodial app brings USDe into everyday payments, savings and cross-border transfers, with annualized rewards of up to 6%.

title: Bitcoin stays flat as global bond bear market rages on, pushing JGB to high
summary: Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs today as Japan’s 10-year JGB yield reached a 30-year peak, keeping Bitcoin steady near $78,000.

title: Fake Claude desktop app spreads crypto-stealing malware
summary: RevStealer targets more than 50 crypto wallets alongside browser passwords, cookies, messaging data and selected documents.

title: Does the Bitcoin rally mean we haven’t wasted our lives in crypto?
summary: Crypto is showing signs of life again, but its biggest wins look different from what early believers imagined. After a decade of building, has it all been worth it?

title: Asia sees digital asset custody infrastructure deals from Ripple, Coincheck
summary: Ripple was among the latest blockchain companies to sign a strategic partnership to build more custody and tokenized asset management solutions for Asian institutional participants.

title: Kast launches stablecoin-powered business platform after $80M raise
summary: Kast aims to onboard between 1,000 and 5,000 active businesses to its new platform by the end of 2026.

title: Lazarus Group-linked addresses move $30M through Hyperliquid
summary: Crypto wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group moved $30 million in digital assets through Hyperliquid, weeks after regulators said they were working on a path to introduce the exchange into US markets.

title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
summary: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.

title: Bitfinex Securities lists tokenized notes tied to Strategy, Metaplanet
summary: Five equity-backed notes issued through Luxembourg’s ORO II fund will trade against dollars, USDT and Bitcoin for eligible non-US investors.
